name: Atonement Under The Law
overview: The Scriptures reveal that atonement under the Law was a sacred process carried out by the priests, as illustrated in Exodus 29 where Aaron and his sons partake of the consecration ram in the holy place to sanctify themselves. This ritual underscores the holiness and separation required in approaching God. Furthermore, Exodus 32 presents Moses interceding on behalf of a sinful people, seeking atonement for their great sin and pleading for God's forgiveness, highlighting the mediatorial role in propitiating God. Together, these passages emphasize the solemn, priestly responsibility in making atonement, which foreshadows the ultimate atonement found in Christ.
